summary: Exelon files a fast-track complaint under FPA section 206 against PJM, arguing the three-year forward period of the Reliability Pricing Model is no longer just and reasonable and asking FERC to adopt a prompt auction run two months before each Delivery Year.
ask: Find the three-year forward period unjust and unreasonable, adopt a prompt auction two months before each Delivery Year from 2030/2031, set a January 1, 2027 refund date, and rule by January 31, 2027.

points.point: Exelon asks FERC to replace the three-year forward period with a prompt auction starting with the 2030/2031 Delivery Year.
points.quote: the just and reasonable replacement rate a “prompt” auction schedule

points.point: Exelon asks for fast track processing and a January 1, 2027 refund date, with an order by January 31, 2027.
points.quote: establish a refund effective date of January 1, 2027, and permit Fast Track processing under Rule 206(h) to facilitate a Commission order by no later than January 31, 2027

points.point: The complaint leaves the 2029/2030 auction in December 2026 and any Reliability Backstop Procurement auction untouched.
points.quote: nothing in this complaint is intended to apply to, or otherwise disrupt the implementation of, the 2029/2030 Delivery Year BRA, which is scheduled to run in December 2026

points.point: Exelon says the 2027/2028 and 2028/2029 auctions cleared at the price cap while falling thousands of MW short of the reserve margin target.
points.quote: the 2027/2028 and 2028/2029 Delivery Year BRAs clearing at the temporary Commission-approved price cap and simultaneously falling thousands of MWs short of PJM’s target Installed Reserve Margin.

points.point: Exelon says forecasts four years ahead structure uncertainty into prices, which large load volatility worsens.
points.quote: it produces market outcomes that charge customers on the basis of parameters estimated four years in advance of delivery completion, thereby structuralizing uncertainty and inaccuracy with no proportional benefit.

points.point: Exelon concedes the prompt auction will not cure all of RPM's problems.
points.quote: the targeted surgery requested in this complaint will not heal all that ails RPM.

throughLine.text: Separate PJM complaint docket on capacity market timing, driven by large load forecast error; it bears on the E-7 adequacy report topic of ensuring generation for existing and new large loads.
